content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to propose a few adjustments before signing:
- Regarding the scope clause, it requires performing extra work without additional pay; I propose that any changes to the scope of work be documented in a written change request and billed at the agreed hourly rates or as a mutually agreed fixed price.
- Regarding the provision for 15 rounds of ordinary revisions, this creates an excessive workload; I propose that the Client shall be entitled to up to three rounds of revisions for each Deliverable.
- Regarding the clause stating invoices are payable Net 60, this delays cash flow; I propose that invoices are payable Net 30.
- Regarding the revision allowance of 15 rounds, this increases workload; I propose a revision allowance of 3 rounds.
- Regarding the payment period of Net 60, this delays cash flow; I propose a payment period of Net 30.

Best regards,
